description: Patent Intelligence ZY: query Search Patent API.

collapseOrderAuthority.description: Array of receiving office priority, only valid when `collapseBy=AUTHORITY`.

limit.description: Returns the number of patents, range 1–1000.

queryText.description: Analytics search query, up to 12,000 characters, supports field prefixes such as `TACD:`, `TAC:`, `TA:` and `AND`/`OR`/`NOT` Boolean operations.

sort.description: Array of sorting conditions, each element is `{field, order}`; `field`: `PBDT_YEARMONTHDAY`, `APD_YEARMONTHDAY`, `ISD`, `SCORE`; `order`: `DESC` or `ASC`.

stemming.description: Whether to enable truncation search: `1` is on, `0` is off.
